newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian dlr bounces as RBA stays silent.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian dlr bounces as RBA stays silent.

text.p: The Australian dollar blipped higher after the Reserve Bank stayed silent at its morning money market operation, confounding speculation it would cut rates.
The market had moved to price in a 0.5 point cut in official rates to 5.00 percent after employment data for May released Thursday proved far weaker than expected.

Dealers said the lack of a move could mean the bank was content to wait and review the situation at its next board meeting on July 1, but the market had been burned too many times by surprise cuts to relax. By 9.32 am (2332 GMT) the dollar had inched up to US$0.7525/30 from an early US$0.7507/12.
